observed: Option b samples 13.0 to 13.8 s. Map, then at 13.2 s a straight-down creek: brown channel between pale wavy banks with round oak crowns. A white car seen from above sits at the right against the lower bank; through its pale roof glass a round wheel and two dark empty seat shapes show. Long thin pale stripes run along the water, one above the car to the frame edge. Small round dot bubbles appear at the slab and in the foam at the car's right end; a short pale diagonal stub sits on the lower-left bank. The top-left oak crown sits just below the disclosure chip with a small gap. Caption begins right under the car's bank at 13.4 s; car above it.
